features.name: Opening hours section
features.description: The site displays the opening hours for the café, dog walker, or repair service.

features.name: Image gallery
features.description: A gallery of images showcasing the café, dog walker's services, or repair service's work.

features.name: Contact form
features.description: A form allowing users to send a message or contact information to the service provider.

constraints: No paid third-party APIs may be used for image gallery or contact form functionality.
The contact form must be accessible and functional without requiring user login.
acceptance_criteria: The opening hours section displays the correct opening times for the café, dog walker, or repair service.
The image gallery contains at least 5 high-quality images relevant to the service provided.
The contact form can be submitted without error, and the user receives a confirmation message.
